# Build a real native string object before passing it through Rust XPCOM

1537 cast a Rust byte-buffer pointer to nsACString for SetByteStringData; 1538 replaces it with nsCString::from and the dereferenced native-string pointer. Accepted request/fetch owners still construct nsCString before using &raw const *string. A byte pointer cast is not a native string object. Preserve the correct pointed-to type and explain its lifetime in SAFETY comments; no compiler/runtime diagnostic is claimed. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Rust string stream ABI correction.
